summary: Re-verified Layer 1.7 logout invalidation after main agent renamed the duplicate /api/auth/logout in server.py to /api/auth/logout-legacy-body. Canonical logout in routes/auth.py:2191 is now the sole handler and is confirmed to (a) flip admin_sessions.is_active=False and (b) call server.invalidate_auth_cache(uid, token_id). All 9/9 e2e tests pass against preview URL. The previous test failure was a test-selector issue: it validated against /api/user/{uid} which bypasses server.get_current_user (does inline jwt.decode), so admin_sessions/cache checks never apply. Test now targets /api/mall/v2/wishlist which routes through server.get_current_user — 401 'Session expired or logged out' returned after logout as expected. Also added coverage for /api/auth/logout-legacy-body (200 OK with body).

minor.issue: These endpoints do their OWN inline jwt.decode and do NOT check admin_sessions.is_active. Result: a logged-out JWT continues to return 200 on these endpoints until natural token expiry. Independent of Layer 1.7 but material: the /api/user/{uid} bypass leaves a session-revocation gap for the primary user-details endpoint. Recommend routing these through server.get_current_user (or the session-checking dep) so revoked tokens are honored uniformly.

routes/users.py imports get_current_user from /app/backend/middleware/auth.py — a SECOND implementation that does not consult the auth-cache, admin_sessions, or invalidate_auth_cache. Two get_current_user implementations in the codebase (middleware/auth.py + server.py) produces subtle security drift: /api/users/{uid} accepts a logged-out JWT. Suggest consolidating on server.get_current_user.

Bare `except Exception: pass` swallows all errors and still returns 200 'Logged out successfully' — makes silent failures of invalidate_auth_cache import undetectable. Add logging.warning inside except.

action_items: Layer 1.7 logout invalidation is FIXED for all routes going through server.get_current_user (mall_v2, admin_unified_spend, referral, mining, prc_lock, notifications, paras_mall). No further action for the original bug.

(Separate, non-Layer-1.7): /api/user/{uid} at server.py:8927 uses inline jwt.decode and never checks admin_sessions.is_active — logged-out JWT still returns 200. Fix by using Depends(get_current_user) instead of inline decode.
(Separate): /api/admin/observability/_require_admin also uses inline jwt.decode — same session-revocation gap. Route through get_current_admin.
(Separate): routes/users.py uses middleware/auth.py:get_current_user (a different, older implementation with no session/cache check). Consolidate on server.get_current_user.
critical_code_review_comments: TWO get_current_user implementations exist (server.py L245 + middleware/auth.py L25). The middleware one has NONE of the Layer 1.7 semantics (no cache, no admin_sessions check). Any router importing from middleware/auth.py silently misses session-revocation. This is a security-relevant divergence that needs to be reconciled — routes/users.py currently uses the wrong one.

Multiple endpoints re-implement JWT decoding inline (server.py:8927, admin_observability._require_admin, routes/auth.py:723) instead of relying on the shared dependency. Any future auth policy change (session revocation, MFA, IP checks, etc.) has to be applied in N places.
logout handler's bare except swallows the invalidate_auth_cache ImportError silently — a package-restructure could break invalidation without any log signal. Log the exception.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layer 1.7 auth-cache + logout invalidation is confirmed working end-to-end for the canonical get_current_user path (server.py). Verified by db-side inspection of admin_sessions doc (is_active=False, logged_out_at set after logout) and by observing 401 'Session expired or logged out' on /api/mall/v2/wishlist immediately after logout using the same JWT. Legacy /api/auth/logout-legacy-body still functional. Separate pre-existing gaps documented in backend_issues.minor — recommend a follow-up cleanup ticket to consolidate get_current_user implementations.
rca of the issue: Original Layer 1.7 blocker (duplicate /api/auth/logout in server.py shadowing routes/auth.py) is fully resolved. The server.py copy is now at /api/auth/logout-legacy-body and includes invalidate_auth_cache(uid) as belt-and-suspenders. The previous test failure re-observed in this iteration was NOT a regression — it was a test-target mismatch: the assertion used /api/user/{uid} which uses inline jwt.decode (server.py:8927) and never consults admin_sessions or the auth cache. Switching the assertion to /api/mall/v2/wishlist (which uses server.get_current_user) confirms 401 after logout. Also verified directly in MongoDB: admin_sessions doc for the logged-out token has is_active=False + logged_out_at timestamp.
